## Install (Windows)

1. Download **Gamespeaker-Setup-…exe** below.
2. Run it. Windows warns you because the app isn't signed: click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
   You only see this once; later updates install themselves.
3. Pick a nickname, enter the server password you were sent, and choose your mic and speakers.

**Mac, Linux or phone:** open https://gamespeaker.duckdns.org in Chrome instead.

**Streaming:** 1080p60 needs about 10 Mbps of upload and 1440p60 about 19 Mbps
(check yours at speedtest.net).
